caption: The drawing shows a piece of furniture composed of wood and leather elements. On the left side, there is a tall wooden structure with ten small drawers stacked vertically, likely for storage, and two pull-out writing surfaces beneath the drawers. The drawers and surfaces are brown, with visible wood grain and small metal handles. Extending from the base of this structure is a flat wooden platform, lighter brown in color, transitioning into a padded leather section attached to the right. The padded section is an upholstered seat, light brown and worn, with a rounded edge and supported by two wooden legs. Connected to this seat is a simple wooden chair back, consisting of two vertical supports joined by two horizontal slats. The drawing is depicted on a plain beige background, and the objects cast subtle, light blue-gray shadows beneath them.
title: Shoemaker's Bench
